 out=O/(name+'-sources.jsonl.gz');counts=collections.Counter();bytes_read=0;toolchains={};files=0

 result=dict(repository=repo,commit=sha,url=url,saved_files=files,uncompressed_selected_bytes=bytes_read,archive_bytes=out.stat().st_size,toolchains=toolchains,lexical_file_counts=dict(counts),scope='Pinned official source preparation only.
